# Cohesion walk walk-02: 40 item-on-target pairs, each on its own spot, real input only.
# Generated by tools/cohesion/gen_walk.py from tools/cohesion/pairs.tsv and setup.json; do not edit by hand.
# Run: bash tools/smoke.sh tools/cohesion/walk-02.txt   then: python tools/cohesion/collect.py run-smoke/smoke-out OUTDIR
@world flat
@gamemode survival
@difficulty easy
@observe 30
wait 40
/gamerule doMobSpawning false
/gamerule doDaylightCycle false
/gamerule doWeatherCycle false
/gamerule doImmediateRespawn true
/gamerule keepInventory true
/gamerule showDeathMessages false
/gamerule spawnRadius 0
/gamerule announceAdvancements false
/time set 6000
/weather clear
/setworldspawn 0 -60 -130
/forceload add -96 -112 96 112
wait 40
/kill @e[type=!minecraft:player]
wait 5
report WALK walk-02 40 pairs

/item replace entity @s weapon.offhand with minecraft:air
wait 10
